proposals.statement: Parents struggle to get information from the school because fee statements are printed and sent home in learners' bags but half never reach parents, and parents call about fees they didn't know they owed

evidence.quote: Fee statements are printed every month and sent home in the learners' bags, and half of them never reach the parents. Then I have parents phoning me about fees they didn't know they owed.

proposals.statement: Reports are printed, put in envelopes, and sent home, taking a week of admin staff's time every term for about nine hundred learners

evidence.quote: Reports are the same. Printed, put in envelopes, sent home. For about nine hundred learners that's a week of the admin staff's time every term.

proposals.statement: Notices are sent via WhatsApp broadcast lists and email, but broadcast lists fill up so parents who change numbers fall off

evidence.quote: Those go on WhatsApp broadcast lists, and by email. But a broadcast list fills up, so we have five of them now, and parents who change their numbers just fall off.

proposals.statement: Absence notes are handwritten in the learner's homework diary or emailed to the class teacher, who may not pass them to the office, causing issues like a learner being marked absent for three days without the office knowing

evidence.quote: Handwritten in the learner's homework diary, or an email to the class teacher, who may or may not pass it on to the office. We had a learner marked absent for three days last term and nobody at the office knew why.

proposals.statement: The project should provide a single place for parents to see what they owe, their child's reports, and school notices, and to report when their child is sick

evidence.quote: One place where a parent can see what they owe, their child's reports and the school's notices, and tell us when their child is sick.

proposals.statement: The project should stop printing reports and fee statements to reduce costs and save admin staff time

evidence.quote: And for us to stop printing. That's a real cost, and a lot of hours.

proposals.statement: The portal must show the current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF, and the reference for EFT payments

evidence.quote: The current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF, and the reference to use for EFT.

proposals.statement: The portal must provide the term report as a PDF, released on the same day for all parents

evidence.quote: The term report as a PDF, the same one we print. Released on the same day for everyone.

proposals.statement: The portal must allow parents to fill in absence notes with the reason and dates, and have both the class teacher and office see them immediately

evidence.quote: Yes, the reason and the dates, and the class teacher and the office both see it straight away.

proposals.statement: The school uses SchoolBase 7, a system from about 2014 that holds learners, parents, fees, and marks, and can export to CSV and produce report PDFs

evidence.quote: On a server in the admin block. It's SchoolBase 7, from about 2014 I think. It holds the learners, the parents, fees and marks. It can export to CSV, and it produces the report PDFs.

proposals.statement: The portal needs to get fresh data from SchoolBase without touching it directly, but the system does not have an API

evidence.quote: Not that I know of. I've asked the supplier and they haven't answered yet.

proposals.statement: Most parents have smartphones but data is expensive, and many are on prepaid plans, so the portal should be light for mobile use

evidence.quote: Most of our parents have smartphones, but data is expensive, and I'd say most of them are on prepaid. I think most parents would use the portal on their phones rather than a computer, but honestly, we'd need to check. We've never asked them.

proposals.statement: The portal must be lightweight with small pages and only download PDFs when opened to accommodate parents with limited data

evidence.quote: So the portal has to be light: small pages, and the PDFs only downloaded when someone actually opens one.

proposals.statement: The portal must respect restrictions per parent, and the office must be able to set them, especially for cases where one parent may not see information due to court orders

evidence.quote: The portal has to respect restrictions per parent, and the office has to be able to set them.

proposals.statement: The data must be hosted in South Africa as per the board's decision

evidence.quote: The board said it must be hosted in South Africa. That came out of the last board meeting.

proposals.statement: The portal should be in isiZulu for notices and main screens to accommodate grandparents who are more comfortable in isiZulu

evidence.quote: English is the school's language, but a lot of our grandparents look after the children, and they're more comfortable in isiZulu. If the notices and the main screens could be in isiZulu too, that would mean a lot.

proposals.statement: The portal should have big, clear text and be accessible to screen readers for parents with visual impairments

evidence.quote: And big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The portal should use the school's maroon color instead of a generic blue

evidence.quote: Oh, and please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.

proposals.statement: The portal must respect parent restrictions set by the office and host data within South Africa

evidence.quote: the portal has to respect restrictions per parent, and the office has to be able to set them
The board said it must be hosted in South Africa

proposals.statement: The finance committee has proposed 250,000 rand for the first year, pending board approval

evidence.quote: The finance committee has proposed two hundred and fifty thousand rand for the first year, all in

proposals.statement: The portal must be ready by June 26 to deliver term two reports

evidence.quote: The term two reports go out on the twenty-sixth of June. We'd like parents to get those through the portal

proposals.statement: The school has 1,650 parent contacts with some families having both parents and grandparents listed

evidence.quote: It's not fourteen hundred parent contacts, it's about sixteen hundred and fifty. A lot of families have both parents and a grandparent listed

proposals.statement: If the first report day goes poorly, parents may lose trust in the portal immediately

evidence.quote: a risk I see is that if the first report day goes badly, parents lose trust in the portal straight away

proposals.statement: The portal will start with a trial for grade eight term one reports in April

evidence.quote: Let's do grade eight in April as the trial
Agreed, grade eight first

proposals.statement: The school has only one IT person who works two days a week

evidence.quote: Me, honestly. I'm the only IT person, and only two days a week

proposals.statement: Booking slots for parents' evenings is planned for later but not for the first version

evidence.quote: Eventually, booking slots for parents' evenings. But not now
